name: Hempstead
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Hempstead, NY 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Hempstead, NY for 2026: tree lightings, Santa, Winter Wonderland and two big light shows, with dates checked.
lede: Hempstead spreads its Christmas across the village and the town: tree and menorah lightings with Santa in early December, a Winter Wonderland at Denton Green, and large light shows nearby.
celebrates: The Village of Hempstead lights its Christmas tree and menorah at Village Hall on December 3, with photos with Santa, carols and performances, and the village follows with its Winter Wonderland at Denton Green on December 18, where its announcement promises Santa, free toy giveaways and holiday treats. The Town of Hempstead adds its own Holiday Lighting Ceremony with Santa at Town Hall plaza on December 4, listed on the town's December calendar of events. Bigger drive and walk through displays at Nassau Coliseum in Uniondale and Eisenhower Park in East Meadow round out the season for families who want more lights.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Hempstead's holiday events from the village or the town, so this page leans on the hosts' own 2026 announcements. The village's calendar shows the Winter Wonderland has been a recurring event: its page for the 2023 edition calls it the 3rd annual Winter Wonderland, held at Denton Green on Thursday, December 21, 2023, from 4:30 to 6:30 pm. The village has also held its tree and menorah lighting in earlier years, including a Tuesday evening lighting with the mayor and a local rabbi.
facts: The village's own Christmas events gather at 99 James A. Garner Way, which is both Village Hall and the address the village gives for Denton Green. The village's calendar page for its 2026 tree lighting is also posted in Spanish, and the Winter Wonderland announcement lists a village phone number for questions, 516-478-6286. The Town of Hempstead's December calendar, published as a PDF, lists holiday tree lightings and celebrations across many hamlets and villages in the town, not just Hempstead itself.
trains: Ride the rails to the holidays. The MTA says the Long Island Rail Road's Holiday Lights Train, a locomotive covered in thousands of lights, runs along all electric branches from Monday, November 23 into January, so families who ride the LIRR this season may spot it. Check the LIRR timetable before you plan a train trip to the events on this page, and bring the children to the window to look for the glowing locomotive.

kidfact: Hempstead's village tree lighting happens outside Village Hall, and the village tells families Santa will be there for photos.
faq: The Village of Hempstead holds a tree and menorah lighting at Village Hall and a Winter Wonderland at Denton Green, and the Town of Hempstead holds a holiday lighting ceremony with Santa at Town Hall. Large light displays at Nassau Coliseum and Eisenhower Park add evening options for families across the town.
Are the Hempstead tree lightings free?

The village and town calendars list the lightings without an admission price, and the village's Winter Wonderland announcement advertises free toy giveaways. Light shows at Nassau Coliseum and Eisenhower Park are ticketed, so check their pages for prices before you go.
Where can kids meet Santa in Hempstead?

Santa appears at the village tree and menorah lighting on December 3, the town's holiday lighting ceremony on December 4 and the Winter Wonderland at Denton Green on December 18, according to the village and town calendars.
Is there a holiday light show near Hempstead?

Yes. The Nassau County Holiday Light Show runs at Nassau Coliseum in Uniondale, and LuminoCity Festival takes place at Eisenhower Park in East Meadow. Both are listed on this page with hours and prices as their hosts publish them.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hempstead for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, at least 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Nassau County Holiday Light Show at Nassau Coliseum) through January 3 (LuminoCity at Eisenhower Park), with the Village of Hempstead tree and menorah lighting on December 3 and the Winter Wonderland at Denton Green on December 18 along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Hempstead

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Hempstead and nearby Uniondale and East Meadow
  • Free events (at least 3): the Village of Hempstead Christmas Tree and Menorah Lighting (December 3), the Town of Hempstead Holiday Lighting Ceremony with Santa (December 4) and the Winter Wonderland at Denton Green (December 18)
  • Tree lightings: village (December 3, 4:30 pm) and town (December 4, 4 pm)
  • Light shows: Nassau County Holiday Light Show at Nassau Coliseum and LuminoCity Festival at Eisenhower Park
  • Season: November 27 to January 3
